description: What a room has been saying: its catch-up summary (and whether messages have landed since), its sidebars with their outcomes, and the most recent messages as plain lines with who said them. Use it when a user asks what happened in a room, what a group decided, or to catch them up. For older talk, pass `before` (a message id: the page ahead of it) or `from` (a time: the page starting then); those return just the messages, with hasEarlier and hasLater. rooms_search finds where something was said. Quote people by name; never present a summary as a decision unless a sidebar settled it.

before.description: A message id: return the messages before it.

from.description: An ISO time: return the messages from then on.

limit.description: How many recent messages to return (default 40).

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: rooms_read
title: Read a room
